text:
incident_bot: PAGER: P1 — elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts on api.prod (alerts: 5xx_rate > 3% for 5m). Paging @ashwin-sre (on-call). Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/5xx-dashboard (last 15m)

ashwin-sre: acked, on it. quick glance: 5xx spike started ~10m ago. throwing 502/504s across multiple frontends. digging into runtime traces.

mike-runtime: seeing a correlated uptick in KV prefix lookup latencies and miss rate. prefix-index miss -> backend fanout -> upstream timeouts. shard hotness looks uneven. suspect index metadata drift after recent rollout to canary.

ashwin-sre: good, can you drop the hot shards list?

mike-runtime: hot shards: 7, 11; miss_rate(shard7)=0.42, miss_rate(shard11)=0.38. small subset of keys returning 5xx from prefix cache worker (internal 500). logs show: "panic: invalid index checksum" on worker-7.

elen-platform: if it's a checksum mismatch we should stop serving that cache partition. temp mitigation: mark shard offline and fall back to KV direct path. That will increase latency but reduce 5xx.

ashwin-sre: do it. how to mark offline?

mike-runtime: run:
```
# mark shard offline in routing table
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/_/shards/7/mark_offline -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```
Then restart prefix-cache worker for shard 7:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/prefix-cache-shard-7
```

claire-sre: doing the curl now (ops creds loaded). posting result: {"status":"ok","shard":7,"state":"offline"} :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: @ashwin-sre incident acknowledged by ashwin-sre. Estimated sla impact: yes — >10% requests hitting fallback path initially.

ashwin-sre: after marking offline, watch 5xx rate. mike, can we also enable fallback routing for enterprise tier so they don't see 502s?

mike-runtime: yes. route policy change:
```
PATCH /routing/policies
{ "route": "*/generate", "fallback": "kv-direct", "scope":"enterprise" }
```
Applied.

ashwin-sre: 5xx trending down from 3.8% -> 1.1% in the last 3m. good sign but still elevated vs baseline 0.2%.

elen-platform: next steps: we need to run a parity repair on shard 7's index files and validate checksums. planning maintenance window ~15m. will coordinate with infra.

claire-sre: infra warns that repair is IO-heavy and could cause extra CPU on the node. recommend we keep shard offline and run repair on a copy.

mike-runtime: agreed. I'll kick off an async repair job that streams index->S3, runs repair, verifies, then we can atomically swap back. command:
```
./tools/kv-index-repair --shard 7 --out s3://repairs/1792004321-shard7 --verify
```
Logs will be in /var/log/prefix-cache/repair-7.log

ashwin-sre: while repair runs, we should also increase prefix cache TTL a little to reduce churn across shards (temporary). ops: set TTL from 30s -> 120s for all prefix caches.

elen-platform: done (config push id: cfg-2026-05-19-ops-342). note: longer TTL may mask fresh data but reduces fanout.

pagerduty-bot: reminder: update incident channel when outage scope changes. Add customer impact note.

claire-sre: customer impact: enterprise tenants "AcmeCorp" and "Zephyr" hit >5% error rate earlier. self-serve and small tenants saw elevated latency but lower error rate. worth contacting Acme SRE to confirm.

ashwin-sre: assigning customer comms -> @elen-platform to draft update and support triage.

elen-platform: draft posted to #customer-success: "We observed elevated 5xx caused by internal KV index corruption affecting a subset of prefix cache shards. We have taken the shard offline and applied fallback routing. We're performing a repair and will follow up with timeline."

mike-runtime: repair job completed and verification passed. checksum validated. rehydrating repaired shard to node pool.

mike-runtime: swap steps:
```
ops-api POST /shards/7/swap_with_repaired --body '{"location":"s3://repairs/1792004321-shard7"}'
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/prefix-cache-shard-7
```

claire-sre: swap done, restart succeeded, shard back ONLINE per ops-api.

ashwin-sre: rolling back the routing fallback for enterprise now so normal fast path resumes.

mike-runtime: routing rollback applied. 5xx down to 0.18% now, latency back near baseline. monitoring 15m.

ashwin-sre: great. customer comms: elen please ping Acme/Zephyr that issue is resolved and include root cause summary + mitigation.

elen-platform: will do. posting follow-up: "Root cause: index checksum drift on prefix-cache shard 7 after last canary rollout -> corrupted index files leading to 500s in prefix cache workers and a request fanout. Mitigation: shard offline + fallback routing + index repair + restart. Next steps: add on-start checksum validation and a canary cleanup job; improve alerts for checksum anomalies."

claire-sre: handing off remaining monitoring to oncall next shift. ashwin, any outstanding actions for postmortem?

ashwin-sre: assign postmortem to eng-runtime (owner: mike-runtime) with eng-infra reviewer (elen-platform). include timeline, release that touched prefix-index metadata, and add test for index checksum validation. target postmortem draft in 48hrs.

mike-runtime: got it. collecting logs and commits. probable reverting change is commit 0a1b2c3 in runtime-indexing; will include details.

ashwin-sre: thanks everyone. closing active page. will leave channel open for 1h for monitoring. :white_check_mark:

incident_bot: Incident resolved. Duration ~45m. Severity: P1 -> mitigated. Postmortem owner: mike-runtime. Follow-up tasks created: #INC-2317 (index checksum validation), #INC-2318 (improve shard monitoring).
